name: National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic – Stays for PhD Students
amount: €1,025.50/month for living costs + optional travel allowance up to €1,500
dlText: Expected 30 Apr 2027, 16:00 Central European time (standing annual deadline; also 31 Oct)
tags: Not for PhD students enrolled in Slovakia
note: Short- or medium-term study/research stay for PhD students enrolled abroad; not a full-degree scholarship.

name: CEU Doctoral Scholarship
amount: Full tuition waiver + monthly stipend (currently EUR 1,880 gross) for up to 4 years
fields: Social sciences, humanities, economics, environmental sciences, network/data science, mathematics
note: Admitted doctoral applicants meeting the deadline are considered automatically for the full scholarship; stipend recipients register as self-employed in Austria.

name: Charles University Full-Time Doctoral Studies (Guaranteed Doctoral Income)
amount: Guaranteed doctoral income of at least 1.2× Czech minimum wage (CZK 26,880/month in 2026/27) for full-time students in the standard 4-year period; English-programme fees are low and faculty-specific
dlText: Set per faculty/programme (mostly spring for autumn entry)
note: All full-time doctoral students receive the guaranteed income (scholarship and/or salary); combined (part-time) students do not.

name: Masaryk University Doctoral Study Income
amount: Guaranteed doctoral income of at least 1.2× Czech minimum wage (CZK 26,880/month in 2026/27) for full-time students in the standard 4-year period (scholarship CZK 12,000–26,880 depending on salary)
note: MU states the scholarship and guaranteed income apply regardless of the language of study; the Faculty of Informatics has abolished its English-PhD fee.

name: Czech Technical University Doctoral Studies (Guaranteed Doctoral Income)
amount: Guaranteed doctoral income of at least 1.2× Czech minimum wage (CZK 26,880/month in 2026/27) for full-time students in the standard 4-year period; FEE English-PhD fee CZK 500/semester
tags: Faculty rules differ for English track
fields: Engineering, computer science, physics and related fields
note: Guaranteed income applies to full-time students who started after 1 Sep 2025; some faculties pay English-track students via a special-purpose scholarship, so confirm with the faculty.

name: Pictus PhD Fellowship Programme
host: Czech Technical University in Prague – Faculty of Electrical Engineering
amount: CZK 69,300 gross/month salary (+ CZK 8,888/month family allowance), 48-month contract
nextText: Further calls may follow (check official page)
tags: Mobility rule: ≤12 months in Czechia in last 3 years
fields: Electrical engineering, computer science, AI, robotics and related topics
note: International PhD programme with a full employment contract; applicants must not have lived or worked mainly in Czechia for over 12 months in the 3 years before the deadline.

name: IOCB Prague PhD Positions
host: Institute of Organic Chemistry and Biochemistry of the Czech Academy of Sciences (IOCB Prague)
amount: Salary from CZK 33,200 gross/month (full-time) on top of the university doctoral stipend
dlText: Expected ~3 Mar 2027 registration (estimated from 2026 call; time not stated)
tags: Enrolled at Charles Univ. or UCT Prague
fields: Chemistry, biochemistry, chemical biology, medicinal chemistry
note: Annual call for PhD projects; students are employed by IOCB and must also apply to a partner university (2026: UCT Prague 15 Apr, Charles University 30 Apr).

name: University of Warsaw Doctoral Schools
amount: Tuition-free + doctoral scholarship PLN 4,346 gross/month (PLN 5,500.50 after mid-term evaluation) for 48 months
dlText: Expected ~21 May 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle, 14 Apr–21 May; time not stated)
fields: Humanities, social sciences, exact and natural sciences, interdisciplinary
note: 325 places in 2026/27; amounts follow the national doctoral scholarship rates and may change with the base rate.

name: Jagiellonian University Doctoral School of Exact and Natural Sciences
amount: Tuition-free + statutory doctoral scholarship for up to 4 years (UJ increased rate from 2026/27: min. PLN 3,549.60 net/month before mid-term; higher afterwards)
dlText: Expected ~15 Jun 2027 for most programmes (estimated from 2026 cycle; varies by discipline)
fields: Computer science, AI, chemistry, physics, astronomy, biology, biophysics, biomedical sciences
note: Every doctoral student without a doctorate receives a scholarship for up to 4 years; project-funded admissions run separately.

name: Warsaw University of Technology Doctoral School
amount: Tuition-free + statutory doctoral scholarship for up to 4 years, increasing after the mid-term evaluation (check official page)
dlText: Expected ~31 Jul 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle, registration from 10 Jun; time not stated)
tags: NAWA recognition statement for non-EU diplomas
note: Non-EU diploma holders need a NAWA recognition statement (allow ~60 days); interviews late Aug–early Sep.

name: AGH University Doctoral School
amount: Tuition-free + statutory doctoral scholarship for up to 4 years, increasing after the interim evaluation (check official page)
dlText: Expected ~30 Sep 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle, 1 Jul–30 Sep; time not stated)
fields: Engineering, earth sciences, materials, computer science, physics
note: Every enrolled doctoral student without a doctorate is eligible for the scholarship for up to 4 years.

name: Warsaw-4-PhD Doctoral School
host: Warsaw-4-PhD (Polish Academy of Sciences institutes incl. IIMCB, Nencki)
amount: Tuition-free + scholarship PLN 5,500/month (PLN 6,000 after mid-term evaluation)
dlText: Three international recruitment rounds per year (2026 rounds closed 31 May and 7 Aug)
note: Project-based admissions announced in IIMCB/partner news before each round; stipend figures from the IIMCB doctoral page.
